name: Clifftop Observatory
description: Ruined observatory where Runara killed a blue dragon a century ago. Sparkrender has claimed it for a ritual when the King-Killer Star comet is nearest. Marble dragon statues veined with gold; energy bridge to tower; star map floor in gold and gems.
itemsOfInterest: D1 — moonstone key slot in dragon statue
D2 Rotunda — golden sculpture (DC 15 Arcana: comet approaching)
Dragon effigies: Astalagan, Clyssavar, Eldenemir, Sharruth, Turadaer
notes:
Requires moonstone key from Runara. Party should complete Ch 2 and Ch 3 first.

Help Mek & Minn vs stirges → friendly kobolds may fetch key.

Finale: fight, negotiate, or creative solutions with Sparkrender.
